**User-friendly description (qm):** Adalet aqqında türlü añlayışlar cemiyet tertibini nasıl şekillendirgenini araştır.

##### Qarar usulınıñ adaletliligini talil etüv

[analyzeProceduralFairness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/analyzeProceduralFairness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the transparency, consistency, and opportunity to contest a decision independent of who benefits from its outcome.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Netice tartışmalı olsa da qarar qabul etüv usulı adaletli olğanını baala.

##### Paylaştırma esaslarını teñeştirüv

[compareDistributivePrinciples.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/compareDistributivePrinciples.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate allocation by need, merit, equality, entitlement, or sufficiency and identify conflicts between principles.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Resurslarnı ihtiyaç, izmet, aqlar ya da teñlik boyunca paýlaştırmaq kerekmi, baala.

##### Teñlik ve adil muamele farqı

[distinguishEqualityFromEquity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/distinguishEqualityFromEquity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare giving identical treatment with responding to relevant differences in needs or disadvantage, without assuming one always settles justice.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Episine bir türlü muamele etüvnen müim farqlarnı közge aluvnı teñeştir.

##### Ayrımcılıq aqqında iddianı baalav

[evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether a distinction in treatment is relevantly justified or imposes an unfair burden on a protected or vulnerable group.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Türlü muamele adaletlimi ya da ayrımcılıqmı, teşker.

#### Huquq felsefesi

Skills: 4

[philosophyOfLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/philosophyOfLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Jurisprudence considers what makes a norm legally valid, why legal institutions claim authority, and how rules should be interpreted. These questions are not limited to any country's current statutes or to political legitimacy in general.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Huquq normalarına akimiyetni ne bergenini ve olarnı nasıl izaat etmek kerek olğanını araştır.

##### Huquqiy pozitivizmnı talil etüv

[analyzeLegalPositivism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeLegalPositivism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate accounts that identify valid law through social sources or institutional practices rather than making moral correctness a necessary condition of legal validity.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qanunnıñ keçerliligi ahlâqiy qıymetine degil, içtimaiy menbalarına bağlı degen fikirni araştır.

##### Tabiiy huquq nazariyesini talil etüv

[analyzeNaturalLawTheory.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeNaturalLawTheory.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate theories that understand legal authority or validity as importantly connected to morality, distinguishing different versions of this connection.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Huquqnıñ akimiyetini ahlâqiy esaslarğa bağlağan fikirlerni teñeştir.

##### Qanun üstünligini talil etüv

[analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine principles such as generality, accessibility, prospectivity, consistent application, and constraints on arbitrary power as grounds for evaluating a legal order.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qanunlarnı açıq, ögden bilinir yapqan ve keyfiy akimiyetni sıñırlağan esaslarnı araştır.

##### Huquqnı izaat etüv nazariyelerini baalav

[evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how text, legislative purpose, precedent, and institutional role support competing interpretations of a legal provision without deciding a real legal dispute.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Metin, maqsat ve mahkeme misalleri huquq normasınıñ izaatına nasıl tesir etkenini tüşün.

#### Siyasiy akimiyet

Skills: 4

[politicalAuthority.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/politicalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Institutions exercise collective power that requires justification. Political legitimacy, coercion, and obedience are distinct concepts.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Siyasiy akimiyetni sırf küçlü degil, qanuniy ve adaletli etken esaslarnı araştır.

##### Vatandaşlıq itaatsizligini talil etüv

[analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the moral conditions, aims, and limits of nonviolent principled lawbreaking without equating legality with morality.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Prinsipial ve zorbalıqsız qanunğa boysunmav haqqında ahlâqiy delillerni muzakere et.

##### İçtimaiy añlaşma delillerini teñeştirüv

[compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternative accounts use consent, cooperation, security, or fairness to justify political obligations.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Devlet müessiseleriniñ qaideler qoyuv aqqını aqlayğan delillerni baala.

##### Siyasiy akimiyetniñ qanuniyligini baalav

[evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine reasons offered to justify the right to make binding public decisions, not merely whether an institution controls force.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Ükümetni razılıq, emniyet ya da işbirliknen aqlayğan delillerni teñeştir.

##### Devlet zorlamasınıñ sıñırlarını baalav

[evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing grounds for restricting individual actions, such as preventing harm or protecting rights.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Şahsiy serbestlikni sıñırlamaq angi allarda aqlı ola bilgenini tüşün.

#### İçtimaiy aqıl ve vatandaşlıq ayatı

Skills: 4

[publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** People with incompatible values must still make shared decisions. Philosophical inquiry examines how disagreements can be handled under pluralism and institutional accountability.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Türlü qıymetlerge saip insanlar episine tesir etken qararlarnı nasıl aqlay bilgenini ögren.

##### Demokratik qanuniylikni talil etüv

[analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the roles of participation, representation, minority protections, and accountability in justifying collective decisions.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İştirak, vekillik ve esabatlılıq demokratiyanı nasıl aqlayğanını tüşün.

##### Umumiy fayda aqqında delilni baalav

[assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine who benefits, who bears costs, and whether a proposed collective interest disregards legitimate dissent.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Umumiy fayda aqqındaki iddia kimniñ menfaatlerini köstergenini teşker.

##### Umumiy deliller ve şahsiy tercihlerni ayırmaq

[distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify justifications aimed at principles others can evaluate, rather than asserting that a personal desire must settle collective policy.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Başqaları paylaşmağa mecbur olmağan şahsiy tercihlerni umumiy delillerden ayır.

##### Siyasiy borc aqqındaki fikirlerni baalav

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider when citizens may have moral reasons to obey, criticize, or resist laws irrespective of mere fear of punishment.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İnsanlar niçün qanunlarğa boysunğanını, olarğa itiraz etkenini ya da qarşı turğanını araştır.

#### Aqlar ve serbestlik

Skills: 4

[rightsAndLiberty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/rightsAndLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İnsanlar angi aqlarnı talap ete bilgenini ve serbestlik ne demek olğanını araştır.

##### Aqlar arasındaki çelişküvni talil etüv

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Müim aqlar arasındaki dava nasıl çözülgenini tüşün.

##### Menfiy ve musbet serbestlikni ayırmaq

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qarışuvdan azat oluvnı tesirli areket etüv imkânınen teñeştir.

##### Aqlar ve imtiyazlarnı ayırmaq

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İnsanğa tiygen aqnı şartnen berilgen imtiyazdan ayır.

##### Vicdan serbestligini añlatuv

[explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İnsanlar diniy ya da diniy olmağan inanışlarğa niçün serbestçe saip olmalı, araştır.

#### Tehnologiyalar ve cemiyet

Skills: 3

[technologyAndSociety.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/technologyAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tehnologiyalar insanlarnıñ areketlerine ve cemiyetke nasıl tesir etkenini talil etmege ögren.

##### Tehnologik sistemalarda insan muhtariyetini talil etüv

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tehnologiyalar insanğa öz qararlarını kontrol etmege ne zaman yardım ya da mania etkenini araştır.

##### Tehnologik vastacılıqnı talil etüv

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tehnologiyalar insanlarnıñ saylav imkânlarını ve munasebetlerini nasıl deñiştirgenini araştır.

##### Tehnologik determinizmni baalav

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yalñız tehnologik deñişmeler cemiyetniñ inkişafını belgileymi dep sual ber.
